agent.interpretation: External CLI/HTTP/MCP automation exercises real shared use cases; synthetic local media, not a claim of autonomous model editing quality

limits: Project removal is irreversible in the public project library; immutable history/audit/media retention roots remain. It is not secure erasure.
Owner-only deletion: 1..64 projects, fixed heads, atomic receipt; active jobs block deletion, receiving uploads abort. Cleanup pending IDs can retry the original request.
Media removal: 1..64 assets, at most128 expanded edit operations; excess rejects the entire request. Related visual nodes are removed; captions retain text and detach the media source.
Current file-paste test dispatches ClipboardEvent with real File bytes; OS clipboard permission/UI and other browsers were not verified.
Cross-platform signed release, 4K/large-project performance and remaining Classic pages/features remain unverified or incomplete.

review.application: Pure base/visual media planning and deletion cleanup port; shared host dispatch, no internal CLI invocation
review.sqlite: Transactional schema25 to26 with collision rollback; fixed heads, atomic batch and audit rollback, exact receipt replay, centralized live-project access/submission checks; copy media roots protected
review.retention: Deletion stores staging IDs before revoking project access; owner retention/cleanup remains possible and audited after deletion, reservation releases only after byte removal
review.ui: View preferences persist only layout/sort; explicit fixed-key AST exception in one UI module. Shift selection follows Classic anchors. Only the active Media/Sounds panel listens for file paste. Replacement target captured before upload.
